sub_indicators.label: ICT employment
sub_indicators.subject: capacity.training
sub_indicators.text: Graduates entering DT ecosystem: ICT employment
sub_indicators.norm_short: Agenda 2063's second ten-year plan asks for 40 per cent of graduates in STEM and youth unemployment down to 14 per cent by 2033; the Continental TVET Strategy asks for wider technical training.
criteria: The latest figure, for 2023 or later, puts employment in information and communication below 0.3 per cent of all employment.
Information and communication employs 0.3 per cent or more of all workers, in the latest figure for 2023 or later, from ILOSTAT's series.
Information and communication employs 0.6 per cent or more of all workers.
Information and communication employs 1 per cent or more of all workers.
Information and communication employs 1 per cent or more of all workers, and youth unemployment is 14 per cent or less on the national labour force survey.
